summary: Controls the Budget reward for reaching the daily water goal.

features.title: Budget reward
features.short: Get paid in your budget for reaching your water goal
features.description:
The server owner can enable Budget rewards in the desktop app settings. Each Apps Hub profile chooses an amount, one or more destination categories and an optional funding category.

When the daily water goal is reached, each chosen category can receive the full reward once for that day. If the profile includes other apps' water from Health, that water also counts towards the goal. The optional source category funds each destination separately. Existing single-category settings remain supported.

Budget must be installed with its App API enabled in Apps Hub → Settings → App APIs; this switch is off by default. Without the Premium module, the desktop reward control opens the Premium prompt and the public page hides the reward. Drink logging and Health integration remain available.
